about_the_game:
Corefall is an immersive open-world survival game set on a large island with diverse biomes and rich lore. Here's what you need to know to get started:

Game Overview:

● Survival and Exploration: Start your journey on the beach with nothing but a torch. Explore the island, gather resources, and build your base to survive.

● Diverse Biomes: The island features three distinct biomes: Desert, Forest, and Winter. Each biome presents unique challenges and resources:

● Desert: The starting biome, home to Rubalt ore.

● Forest: Rich with Emeralt ore and colder temperatures.

● Winter: The most challenging biome with Cobalt ore and harsh cold.

Key Features:

● Crafting and Building: Utilize a comprehensive crafting system to create tools, weapons, and structures. Progress through tiers of tools and materials, from basic wood to advanced iron and ore-infused items.

● PvP and Raiding: Engage in player-vs-player combat. Raid other players' bases using crafted tools like Cluster Bombs and C4. Each raid tool has unique mechanics and crafting requirements. Customize your weapons with attachments and personalize your base.

● Dynamic World: Experience dynamic weather, day-night cycles, and a living world with wildlife and enemy AI. Encounter bandits, passive animals, and aggressive, ore-infused wildlife.

● Multiplayer Experience: Join a server, form alliances, and compete with others. When a player dies, they drop all their belongings, adding high stakes to every encounter.

● Community and Social Features: Connect with other players through emotes, quests, and in-game vendors.

Join the Community:

●Discord Server: Stay updated on development, discuss strategies, and share your experiences with fellow Core Seekers.

●Events and Updates: Participate in community events, provide feedback, and watch as the game evolves based on player input.

Prepare yourself for an unforgettable survival adventure in Corefall. Gather resources, build your fortress, and dominate the island as you uncover the secrets of the ancient ores.

content_descriptors.notes: Contains violence and online interactions with other players.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-3770 / AMD FX-9590 or better
  • Memory: 10 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 1050 / AMD 500 Series or better
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11 64bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-4790K / AMD Ryzen 5 2600 or better
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: RTX 3060 / RX 570 Series or better
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 5 GB available space

short_description: Corefall is a hardcore multiplayer survival FPS with a focus on competitive gunplay and base building. Kill, loot, survive.
